_comment: Edit this list freely. Matching is case-insensitive and looks for these as substrings in call titles/descriptions. Keep phrases specific enough to avoid noise (e.g. 'hydrogen' alone will match a lot of unrelated chemistry calls).
_comment_standing_calls: Standing/general Spanish R&D funding instruments to always flag when they're published, regardless of technical topic - these are broad programs (any field can apply) rather than topic-specific calls, so they're matched separately against BDNS only and shown on the dashboard with a distinct 'standing call' badge.
